crossRefs.note: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will…
Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening…

translations.web: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
translations.bsb: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is still young.
translations.kjv: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
translations.asv: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
